title: 'Tied up, tortured': UP man claims wife held him captive, gave electric shocks

author: TOI LEGAL DESK
description: The National Consumer Commission ordered Mahindra to replace a Marazzo engine free of cost. The company and its dealer must also pay the customer one lakh rupees in compensation. This decision came after their claim about bad fuel causing damage was found untrue. The commission noted inconsistencies in the dealer's fuel test report and its timing. Lower courts' decisions were set aside due to flawed analysis of evidence.
title: Mahindra car developed engine trouble within months; owner wins Rs 1 lakh and new engine

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Andrew Ng outlines three key loops for building software with artificial intelligence. The agentic coding loop allows AI agents to write and test code autonomously. Developers then steer AI agents through a feedback loop, focusing on higher-level product decisions. External feedback loops involve real-world user interaction and testing. Humans retain a significant advantage due to their contextual understanding of users and products.
title: Google Brain cofounder writes an open letter on 'Loop engineering'

author: TOI DEFENCE DESK
description: China's recent submarine missile test in the Pacific drew sharp reactions from the United States and regional nations. The United States accused Beijing of rapidly expanding its nuclear arsenal and urged arms control talks. Several Indo-Pacific countries, including the Philippines and Taiwan, described the launch as destabilizing and provocative. Analysts view the test as a significant milestone in China's growing sea-based nuclear deterrent capability.
title: US, allies rattled after China's missile test - why the launch set off alarm bells

author: SAHIL MALHOTRA
description: India's T20I squad overhaul has raised fresh questions after Player of the Tournament Sanju Samson was dropped from the Zimbabwe series despite his World Cup heroics, with selectors prioritising teenage sensation Vaibhav Sooryavanshi. Meanwhile, discussions are underway over whether Gautam Gambhir and the regular support staff will travel to Zimbabwe due to the quick turnaround, while last-minute changes to India's Asian Games squad also remain on the cards.
title: Decoding the selection call that ended Samson's T20 WC high - and the road ahead

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Japan's coast guard expelled Chinese vessels from waters near disputed islands. China stated its coast guard warned and expelled an intruding Japanese fishing boat. The confrontation occurred amid already strained ties between the two Asian powers. The Senkaku-Diaoyu islands remain a major flashpoint for decades. The East China Sea region is strategically important due to proximity to Taiwan.
title: Japan, China clash in high-stakes maritime standoff near disputed islands

author: TOI WORLD DESK
title: 'We're watching closely': US Senator warns Pak over 'double role' after Khamenei tribute

author: TOI DEFENCE DESK
title: Astra missiles, BrahMos & Sabang port: India, Indonesia sign big defence, cooperation deals

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: At his last World Cup, Cristiano Ronaldo made headlines by attempting numerous shots yet shockingly, none translated into goal-scoring opportunities, establishing a record for missed chances. While his playmaking seemed to deteriorate, he still managed to net three goals from seventeen attempts. Ultimately, Portugal's journey ended prematurely with their exit in the Round of 16.
title: Cristiano Ronaldo sets unwanted World Cup record, becomes player with most...

author: KHUSHI BHUTA
description: A newlywed woman died after allegedly falling from a building in Delhi. Her family accused her husband and relatives of dowry harassment and abuse. The woman had reportedly told her mother about physical beatings and fears for her life. Police have arrested her husband and registered a dowry death case. Investigations are ongoing into the circumstances surrounding her death.
title: 'He will kill me': Delhi newlywed told mother days before fatal fall; husband held

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Cristiano Ronaldo stated Portugal's Euro 2016 win holds immense personal value. He expressed disappointment after Portugal's World Cup exit, his final campaign. Ronaldo affirmed he gave his best and has no regrets about his efforts. He won three titles for Portugal, ending their trophy drought. The Euro 2016 victory remains a defining achievement in his career.
title: 'Euro is just as significant as World Cup': Ronaldo sparks debate after Portugal exit

author: TIMESOFINDIA.COM
description: French captain Kylian Mbappé condemned racist social media posts by a Paraguayan senator.  The senator's remarks targeted Mbappé's background and appearance after a World Cup match.  Paraguay's government and the French Football Federation also denounced the senator's unacceptable comments.  French officials, including President Macron, voiced strong support for Mbappé and condemned racism.  This controversy follows similar remarks made by a former Paraguayan goalkeeper before the game.
title: 'Despicable woman': Kylian Mbappé explodes at Paraguay senator over racist attack

author: TOI WORLD DESK
title: Bomb blast at anti-Sheikh Hasina rally in Bangladesh, three injured

author: LACHIT ROY
description: Luka Dončić turned heads by repeatedly choosing Nikola Jokić over LeBron James and other NBA legends in a rapid-fire "ultimate teammate" challenge. The viral clip surfaced shortly after James' Lakers exit, fueling fan speculation. While reports indicate no tension between the former teammates, many viewed Dončić's choice as a reflection of ideal 2-on-2 chemistry rather than a slight against James.
title: Luka Doncic leaves LeBron James behind, makes surprising Nikola Jokić pick in rapid-fire

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Belgium ended the United States’ World Cup 2026 dream with a ruthless 4-1 victory in Seattle, reaching the quarter-finals after punishing costly defensive errors. Charles De Ketelaere scored twice, while Hans Vanaken and Romelu Lukaku completed the rout. Despite dominating possession, Mauricio Pochettino’s hosts fell short of a first World Cup quarter-final since 2002.
title: FIFA World Cup: Belgium march into quarter-finals after ruthless 4-1 demolition of USA

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Caviar has unveiled luxury versions of Apple's rumored foldable iPhone Ultra.  These custom devices feature 24K gold and genuine crocodile leather.  The "Flagship" collection offers four distinct design solutions for the upcoming phone.  Technical specifications are based on rumors, including a titanium body and advanced cameras.  Pre-orders for these exclusive reimagined iPhones start at $13,840.
title: Luxury brand 'creates' foldable iPhone Ultra in 24K gold, some silver, and a lot more

author: TOI WORLD DESK
title: 'Before warning signs become mass graves': UN chief sounds alarm over rising global conflicts

author: RAJIV KALKOD
description: Avalahalli police arrested Shekhappa for his infant daughter's murder.  The child's death was not accidental, as initial reports suggested.  Investigations revealed injuries inconsistent with a fall from a cot.  The post-mortem indicated extensive internal injuries and respiratory failure.  Shekhappa's wife, Vijayalakshmi, is currently absconding from authorities.
title: Bengaluru couple kill 11-month-old daughter, pass off death as cot fall

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Belgium decisively defeated the United States 4-1 in the World Cup Round of 16. Folarin Balogun, whose suspension was controversially overturned, struggled to impact the match. He registered few touches and failed to score during the game. The United States faced elimination in the Round of 16 once again. This defeat concluded their home World Cup aspirations after much scrutiny.
title: After all the drama... Balogun's controversial FIFA reprieve ends with little impact

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A senior Trump administration official said Netanyahu had repeatedly made optimistic predictions about the course of the war that ultimately failed to materialise. The official's comments reflected growing scepticism within the administration over Netanyahu's assessments of the conflict and signalled that Washington intends to independently verify future claims before acting on them.
title: 'Bibi made rosy predictions': US miffed at Netanyahu's promises about Iran war

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Amitabh Bachchan personally called The House of Abhinandan Lodha founder and chairman Abhinandan Lodha at around 3 am to enquire about buying land in Ayodhya and transferred Rs 15 crore the very next day after learning the price, the real estate entrepreneur has revealed. Bachchan has steadily expanded his real estate portfolio in Ayodhya over the past few years.
title: Amitabh Bachchan called at 3 am to buy Ayodhya land, transferred Rs 15 crore next day

author: TOI BUSINESS EXPERTS
description: Alpha continues its steady box office run after a strong opening weekend. The film collected an estimated Rs 3.85 crore net on its fourth day. Its total India gross collection reached an estimated Rs 45.34 crore. Overseas earnings pushed the worldwide gross to an estimated Rs 63.64 crore. The movie is now on its way to the Rs 100 crore milestone.
title: 'Alpha' hits Rs 63.64 crore worldwide on first Monday; eyes Rs 100 crore mark

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: Oil prices saw a slight increase Tuesday after a tanker was struck near the Strait of Hormuz.  This incident raised security concerns on a vital global oil shipping route.  However, market gains were limited as traders focused on rising crude supplies.  The United Arab Emirates and OPEC+ have agreed to increase their oil production levels.  Saudi Arabia also lowered its August crude selling price for Asian markets.
title: Oil prices inch higher as focus shifts to supply, demand and Hormuz shipments

author: TOI WORLD DESK
title: Oil tanker hit at Hormuz: US accuses Iran of attacking 2 commercial ships, mulls action

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: As the tech landscape evolves with AI data centers, electricity costs are soaring. Henrico County, Virginia, has announced a staggering 25% hike in electricity bills for government facilities, prompting local officials to urge power conservation among their employees. Residents are also feeling the pinch, with some facing bill doubles. This phenomenon underscores the mounting pressure on community resources amid the rapid expansion of data centers.
title: Virginia county manager: Electricity rates to rise sharply from July 1

author: JOY SENGUPTA, NISHA NAMBIAR, GITESH SHELKE
title: For hours, Pune cut off from Mumbai as rain hits highways, buses and railway tracks

author: NISHA NAMBIAR
description: A major landslide on the Pune-Mumbai Missing Link caused an eighteen-hour traffic shutdown. Nearly one hundred tonnes of mud and rock fell onto the road near tunnel two. The incident occurred after rainfall three times the average in twenty-four hours. Officials are consulting IIT-Bombay for a technical assessment of the route. Public safety remains the highest priority for the MSRDC.
title: Pune-Mumbai Expressway ‘connecting link’ goes back to being ‘missing link’ for 18 hours after landslide

author: PATHIKRIT CHAKRABORTY
description: A special investigation team is examining over Rs 124 crore spent on major Ram Temple Trust events.  The Jan 2024 consecration ceremony alone saw Rs 113 crore in expenditures.  Investigators are auditing financial records and payment vouchers from the past two years.  Donations of precious metals and jewellery are also being verified by the SIT.  The probe ensures funds were utilized according to prescribed financial procedures and approvals.
title: SIT probing Rs 124 crore spent by Trust on Ram temple events over 2 years

author: BARSHA DUTTA
description: The Dallas Cowboys nearly completed a draft-day trade with the Kansas City Chiefs to move up for safety Caleb Downs, head coach Brian Schottenheimer revealed. The Chiefs instead traded to No. 6 for Mansoor Delane, forcing Dallas to adjust and trade from No. 12 to No. 11, where they still selected Downs. Schottenheimer said Downs topped the Cowboys' draft board, while the rookie is already being tipped as a breakout player entering training camp.
title: Cowboys-Chiefs draft trade for $6M safety finally comes to light

author: TNN & Agencies
description: Saudi Arabia significantly reduced crude oil prices, reflecting intense competition among producers. Major Persian Gulf nations are increasing their oil output, restoring pre-war export levels. This move coincides with OPEC+ allies agreeing to further boost production targets for August. Lower oil prices and increased supply will benefit Indian refiners and reduce government subsidy burdens. Reduced energy costs for Indian companies will help control inflation and support consumer spending.
title: Saudi Arabia effects deepest crude price cut in 26 years

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Cristiano Ronaldo's FIFA World Cup journey concluded with Portugal's Round of 16 elimination.  He expressed sadness and confirmed this was his final tournament appearance.  Ronaldo stated he gave his best and leaves with a clear conscience.  Portugal coach Roberto Martinez praised his influence and legacy in football.  Ronaldo's career includes major international titles and scoring records.
title: Ronaldo breaks down in tears as Portugal World Cup dream ends - Watch

author: TNN
title: TTP claims responsibility for killing Pakistan Air Force officer in Islamabad

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Cristiano Ronaldo's illustrious World Cup journey came to an emotional end as Portugal faced defeat against Spain. While sadness enveloped him, he remained proud of his legacy, being the sole player to score in six different World Cups. Having secured three titles with Portugal, including the 2016 Euros, he announced this bittersweet event as his last World Cup appearance, marking the conclusion of an era.
title: Tears and applause: Cristiano Ronaldo bows out of his final World Cup with a heartbreak

author: PATHIKRIT CHAKRABORTY
description: Ayodhya Police are considering narco-analysis and polygraph tests for five jailed accused. These examinations aim to unravel a larger conspiracy and establish the money trail. The police secured court permission to interrogate the accused inside the district jail. Investigators believe these tests will resolve statement contradictions and trace siphoned funds. The probe also examines institutional lapses and senior functionaries' potential involvement in the embezzlement.
title: Ayodhya cops eye narco, polygraph tests in Ram Temple donation theft probe

author: RAJEEV DIKSHIT
description: A man allegedly murdered and dismembered his girlfriend after suspecting her of phone infidelity. Police arrested the 42-year-old boyfriend, Hemal Khakharia, following a shootout and encounter. The victim's body parts were found stuffed in black plastic bags along a roadside. Khakharia confessed to the crime after being apprehended with the remaining body parts. The victim, a married woman, had met Khakharia through social media two months prior.
title: UP man kills girlfriend for refusing to show WhatsApp chats

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: In a radical move, Ignaz Semmelweis mandated handwashing in hospitals, drastically reducing maternal mortality rates. Despite evidence supporting his approach, he faced fierce opposition from fellow medical professionals, as he couldn't provide a scientific rationale for his findings. Much later, the establishment of germ theory validated his revolutionary work, leading to fundamental changes in medical practices that ultimately saved innumerable lives.
title: 1847 discovery: Chlorine handwashing cut childbirth deaths 90%, doctors ignored it
